title: Schema.org MediaObject
description: A media object, such as an image, video, audio, or text object embedded in a web page or a downloadable dataset.

name.description: The name of the media object.

description.description: A description of the media object.

contentUrl.description: Actual bytes of the media object.

embedUrl.description: A URL pointing to a player for the media.

encodingFormat.description: Media type expressed using a MIME format.

bitrate.description: The bitrate of the media object.

duration.description: The duration of the item in ISO 8601 format.

productionCompany.description: The production company or studio performing the work.

uploadDate.description: Date when this media object was uploaded.

requiresSubscription.description: Indicates if use of the media requires a subscription.

regionsAllowed.description: The regions where the media is allowed.

associatedArticle.description: A NewsArticle associated with the media object.

sameAs.description: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity.
